identity.title: Spherical Caps do Not Always Maximize Neumann Eigenvalues on the Sphere

problems.title: Missing connected-exterior hypothesis in the general hole perturbation result

locations.object: hole hypotheses and exterior problems W,L
uniform extension, compactness and fixed-index convergence (13)

problems.claim: The written assumptions permit a compact connected annular hole with a bounded complementary component; the general extension inequality and fixed-index asymptotic are false for it.
problems.all_hypotheses: omega={1<=|x-(2,0)|<=3} is compact, smoothly bounded and connected, and 1<|(2,0)|=2<3 puts 0 in its interior. For Proposition 3 take M=Omega=S^2, empty boundary allowed, phi=0, N=1, south-pole conformal chart psi(x)=(4x1/(4+|x|^2),4x2/(4+|x|^2),(|x|^2-4)/(4+|x|^2)), rho(0)=1, epsilon<r/5. Original cluster I={1,2,3}, mu=2, neighbors 0 and 6.
problems.decisive_proof: On the annulus h=log(3/r)/log3, extended by 1 to the cavity and 0 outside radius 3, is compact H1 and harmonic in the hole; outside gradient energy is 0, inside energy 2*pi/log3. The sphere after removal has two components, hence mu0=mu1=0. Wouter=9(x-c)/r^2 and Winner=-(x-c) have coordinate energies 9*pi and pi; |omega|=8*pi gives M=18*pi*I and kappa=(-27/2,-27/2,12). Thus |0-2+(27/2)epsilon^2| cannot be O(epsilon^(9/4)). For each diagonal L entry the cavity boundary flux would be pi, impossible for a harmonic function.
problems.counterreadings: The annulus itself is connected. Reading 'hole' as a filled obstacle imposes an additional hypothesis. Discarding the extra zero mode would conflict with the stated multiplicity indexing and mean-zero min-max definition. W nonuniqueness affects additive cavity constants but not the calculated M.
problems.actual_impact: General Proposition 3, Lemma 7 and exterior-corrector assertions need a topological restriction. The four filled ellipses in Section 4 and the expressly simply connected fixed hole in Section 6 exclude the counterexample. No main Theorem 1 failure is established.
problems.severity_reason: Local excess scope is removable by a hypothesis already satisfied in the demonstrated principal applications; no surviving core dependence failure is shown.
problems.repair: Require connected complement, for example smooth filled simply connected holes; add matching condition to Lemma 7. Inverted complement then supports a single-mean Poincare inequality followed by trace extension and harmonic minimization. A theorem with cavities would require new component/index analysis.
problems.repair_limits: The suggested restriction and local proof step were mathematically checked. No corrected author manuscript, general cavity theorem, or author adoption is claimed.
problems.independent_calculation: Reviewer-authored exact Fraction arithmetic and Simpson energy quadrature, exit 0; analytical topology/PDE proof remains decisive.

independent_acceptance.source_locations: Section 3.1 pp.3-4; Proposition 3 p.5; compactness and (13) p.7; Lemma 7 p.22.
independent_acceptance.hypotheses: Omega=M=S^2 is expressly permitted; empty boundary and zero boundary field are admissible. The compact connected smooth annulus 1<=|x-(2,0)|<=3 contains 0 in its interior; its diameter bound fits the chart for epsilon<r/5. I={1,2,3} is a complete positive cluster with gaps 0<2<6. No connected-exterior hypothesis is stated.
independent_acceptance.decisive_evidence: The continuous piecewise logarithmic h is compactly supported H^1, harmonic on the annulus, with interior energy 2*pi/log(3)>0 and exterior energy zero. Removal leaves two components, so the paper's multiplicity indexing and mean-zero min-max give mu_1(Omega^epsilon)=0 for every sufficiently small epsilon, instead of convergence to 2. W=9(x-c)/|x-c|^2 outside and -(x-c) inside has coordinate energies 9*pi and pi; M=(8+9+1)*pi I=18*pi I, yielding kappa=(-27/2,-27/2,12). The diagonal L problem requires disk outward flux pi, incompatible with harmonicity.
independent_acceptance.counterevidence: The initial introduction calls mu_1 positive, but Section 3 allows the stated hole family without a connectedness preservation assumption, and the explicit variational indexing cannot discard the additional kernel. The actual Section 4 ellipses are filled, and Section 6 expressly fixes a smooth simply connected hole.
independent_acceptance.core_dependency: The general Lemma 7 uniform extension is used in p.7 compactness and the fixed-index Proposition 3. The extra cavity zero mode invalidates these statements at their written generality.
independent_acceptance.severity_basis: A connected-exterior restriction excludes the counterexample and is already satisfied by both principal applications. It supports the single-mean Poincare step after inversion; no surviving core failure is established. Minor remains calibrated.
independent_acceptance.repair_limits: A theorem allowing bounded complementary components would require componentwise compatibility and different index accounting. Only the stated restriction/local extension repair is verified, not a general cavity theorem.
